entities.summary: Virgil Leo Green is an American college football coach and former professional tight end. He is the tight ends coach for the University of Nevada, Reno, a position he has held since 2023. He played college football at Nevada and was selected by the Denver Broncos in the seventh round of the 2011 NFL draft.
